_doc: Pueblo Motorsports Park through Lake Murray v4's engine (ledger 0078). The line, widths and profile are tracks/pueblo's (installed 0.67.0), read by tools/lm_engine_intake.py; the profile is the measured one with the elevation stage's grade cap undone; no lidar camber (the G10 survey found no usable cloud here: source/lidar/camber-survey/README.md), so flat; the 3DEP grid is this port's own fetch (the live track commits none); the edge is the circuit's (no curb, no sidewalk). Every other key is the live track's, copied; the live config is untouched.

source._smooth_window_doc: 2026-11-01 (ledger 0060, High Plains' lesson): source/osm_fixes.json is a list of 128 OSM nodes (6 m apart on the corners, up to 504 m on the straights), not a 1 Hz GPS drive; from_track's 5-fix moving average put the line 1.75 m median / 3.64 p95 / 6.59 m max off the source polygon and shortened the lap 3,511 -> 3,460 m. 0 = no smoothing: the line is the OSM polygon resampled at 3 m (build_mesh still corner-rounds it for the sweep). The closing 350 m (last node -> first) is the front straight's own segment (0.0 / 6.7 deg turn at its ends), not a chord.
source._note: Real 2.2-mi (~3510 m) paved ROAD COURSE at Pueblo Motorsports Park, 3733 N Pueblo Blvd, Pueblo CO. From OSM highway=raceway ways 558378826+558378823+558378824 (drag-strip staging spur excluded). Native ring winding is CW; fixes kept CW. Resampled to 3 m via scripts.gps.from_track. Flat/rolling road course — elevation from USGS 3DEP bare-earth (do NOT flatten); NO banking (not an oval).

road_profile._doc: Flat road course — no banking. dips/cambers intentionally empty; deck follows bare-earth 3DEP.

route._orientation_doc: Research 2026-07-20: Pueblo Motorsports Park is CLOCKWISE ONLY (track rules); our ring is already CW. S/F on the wide west-side front straight near its south end (~38.3000,-104.6774), raced NNW-bound. Pit lane: east of the front straight (driver's right), ~350 m.

edge._grass_clearance_doc: 0.1.3 (PC, 2026-11-09; Kevin, asked whether the other circuit tracks have Milford's fast-curve edge mess: "Yes, check them"; Milford 0.1.6 is the same fix, ledger 0087): the strip's outer lip 2 cm under the lane edge (profile point 3 at -grass_clearance = +0.08 over the unlifted edge; the lane edge at +0.10). engine-july's prep holds the ground past the ROAD edge at the lane edge's height - 0.02 for 3 m (its contact band), so the lower lip lay in a gutter with a wall of ground at its lip. Measured on the installed 0.1.2 (gate OBJ, every 10 m, both sides; strip_gutter.py): the strip's lip 14 cm under the lane edge; the ground just past it stood more than 5 cm over the lip at 31 of 586 side-stations, more than 10 cm at 11 (max 12 cm). Flush with the band, nothing stands over it
edge._doc: the circuit edge (ledger 0078): no curb, no sidewalk. The asphalt edge is held at road height for 0.30 m and the run-off ground meets it 0.15 m lower over 1.0 m [invented: the flush meet the drive gate reads as no drop]; the ground beyond is the assembler's conform to the road, then the 3DEP surface: the real run-off level.
